verdict.rationale: Pendo documents its own REST API usage: track events can be sent as REST API calls (pendo-docs-20), and a documented API endpoint bulk-deletes accounts and visitors (pendo-docs-22). That confirms a public API exists, but the evidence covers only narrow ingestion and deletion operations, not broad programmatic control of the product, and no OpenAPI spec was found (pendo-probe-3). The mobile SDK APIs (pendo-docs-19) are instrumentation interfaces, and the MCP server belongs to a different story, so neither is credited here. Missing for 10: evidence the API can drive core product functions (querying analytics, managing guides and segments), a published API reference or OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
